integrity: Uniform argument uses the standard natural cellular model and signed cochain traces; finite standalone exact checks corroborate the group character formulas, without independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only rational cohomology degrees 3 and 4 and their D_n-quotient dimensions. No integral quotient or higher-degree calculation. A relevant 2022 polygonal quotient paper could be checked only at abstract level; priority unresolved.
title: Dihedral low-degree cohomology of polygonal moment-angle manifolds
